result.response:
I have run `defects4j test` to run the test suite and verify that the fix introduces no regressions. I will check the results once the test execution finishes.
### Investigation & Root Cause

The test [`StringEscapeUtilsTest.testLang720`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_a_blind/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringEscapeUtilsTest.java#L428-L432) checks escaping for a string containing characters outside the BMP (supplementary planes), specifically `"\ud842\udfb7" + "A"`.

In [`CharSequenceTranslator.translate(CharSequence, Writer)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/translate/CharSequenceTranslator.java#L75-L104):
1. The loop bound was calculated as `len = Character.codePointCount(input, 0, input.length())` instead of the character sequence length (`input.length()`).
2. Translators take character indices as their `index` argument, not codepoint indices.
3. When a character was not translated (`consumed == 0`), `Character.toChars(Character.codePointAt(input, pos))` correctly wrote the surrogate pair (consuming 2 `char`s), but `pos` was only incremented by 1 at the end of the loop, causing the low surrogate to be processed separately on the next iteration.

### Fix

Updated [`CharSequenceTranslator.translate(CharSequence, Writer)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/translate/CharSequenceTranslator.java#L80-L100):
- Used `len = input.length()` to iterate across character offsets.
- When `consumed == 0`, increment `pos += c.length` and continue to ensure multi-char codepoints (surrogate pairs) advance `pos` by the number of code units written.
- When `consumed > 0`, advance `pos` by the character count of each consumed codepoint.

### Verification

```bash
export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; export _JAVA_OPTIONS='-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US -Duser.timezone=America/Los_Angeles'
defects4j test -t org.apache.commons.lang3.StringEscapeUtilsTest::testLang720
defects4j test
```
